key_insight: Shared curvature enables Newton-based bilevel optimization beyond lower-level strong convexity, including settings with nonunique solutions and singular Hessians.
engineering_relevance: The methods broaden Newton-based tools for hyperparameter optimization, data reweighting, and meta-learning when standard hypergradient assumptions fail.
method: Newton-based GALET exploits curvature range structure under a positive spectral gap, avoiding GALET’s squared-Hessian multiplier system.
Newton-based BAMM uses strongly convex aggregation when the lower-level objective is convex and the upper-level objective is strongly convex in the lower-level variable.
GNBO unifies the shared-curvature structure of the proposed methods and several existing Newton and quasi-Newton bilevel methods.
evidence_signal: The paper establishes convergence and improved complexity bounds over GALET and sl-BAMM under corresponding assumptions, and evaluates synthetic problems, data hyper-cleaning, and GPT-2 data reweighting.
watch_item: Guarantees remain conditional on spectral-gap or convexity assumptions; the abstract reports no quantitative empirical gains.
paper_title: Newton-Based Methods for Bilevel Optimization Beyond Lower-Level Strong Convexity
